reader_sentence: Across GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M, and Gemma-2-2B, integrated gradients matches attention-head ablation effects far better than the other attribution methods (mean Spearman ρ ≈ 0.84), ahead of attribution patching (0.62), gradient × input (0.45), saliency (0.29), and activation magnitude (0.18), and this ranking holds for all three models.
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
reason: The summary states that integrated gradients is best on all three models at about 0.84, clearly ahead of attribution patching at 0.62, which matches the intended finding.
